jobs.title: Senior Financial Analyst, Corporate FP&A
jobs.description:
Do you want to shape financial decisions that reach the highest levels of executive leadership and the Board of Directors? Are you energized by turning complex financial data into clear, compelling narratives that drive strategy?

  

As a Senior Financial Analyst in Corporate FP\&A, you’ll support the enterprise\-level consolidation of Disney’s Entertainment \& Sports segments, partnering with senior finance leaders to deliver forecasts, operating plans, long\-range plans, and strategic analyses that inform leadership decisions. You’ll join a high\-performing team that translates business performance and long\-term strategy into materials for senior management and the Board, while driving continuous improvement in how the Company plans, forecasts, and communicates results.

  

What You’ll Do  

* Lead financial planning deliverables for businesses within the Entertainment \&


Sports segments, including quarterly forecasts, annual operating plans, and long\-  

range plans used by executive leadership and the Board of Directors  

* Develop executive\-ready materials that clearly communicate financial


performance, risks, opportunities, and strategic tradeoffs to multiple audiences,  

including senior management and enterprise leadership  

* Monitor and analyze business performance, identifying key drivers, variances,


and emerging trends across revenue, costs, profitability, and KPIs  

* Partner closely with segment and business unit finance teams to validate


assumptions, improve forecast accuracy, and align near\-term performance with  

long\-term strategic objectives  

* Support enterprise\-level strategic analyses, including valuation work, scenario


modeling, and investment decision support across businesses  

* Collaborate cross\-functionally with Corporate Strategy, Investor Relations,


Treasury, Segment Planners, and other finance teams to support long\-term  

planning, capital allocation, and external financial messaging  

What We’re Looking For  

* 4\+ years in FP\&A, Strategy, Consulting, or related finance roles
* High proficiency in Excel and PowerPoint, building financial presentations for


executives; experience with Cognos and Oracle EPM preferred  

* Strong modeling background (P\&L, cash flow, valuation, scenario planning)
* Demonstrated ability to prepare materials for senior leadership and/or Board\-


level audiences, with exceptional attention to detail  

* Comfort working in a fast\-paced, highly visible environment with competing


priorities and tight timelines  

* Strong collaboration skills and the confidence to engage with senior stakeholders


across finance and the business  

* A self\-starter who can drive transformation within the team
* Role requires working onsite 4 days per week
  

Why This Role  

This role offers direct exposure to enterprise\-level decision\-making, meaningful  

ownership over high\-impact financial materials, and the opportunity to shape how Disney  

evaluates performance and strategy across two of its most important businesses. You’ll  

grow as a professional while working alongside exceptional finance partners.

  

The hiring range for this position in California is $104,800\.00\-$128,000\.00 per year. The base pay actually offered will take into account internal equity and also may vary depending on the candidate’s geographic region, job\-related knowledge, skills, and experience among other factors. A bonus and/or long\-term incentive units may be provided as part of the compensation package, in addition to the full range of medical, financial, and/or other benefits, dependent on the level and position offered.

jobs.title: Sr Financial Analyst
jobs.description:
Clear Channel Outdoor  



**Job Summary:**


Provides support in one or more of several specialty areas within the Finance and Accounting function including: Cost Accounting, Business Support, Financial Planning and Reporting, Tax, Audit, Accounting Services and Centralized Transactions.  



**Job Responsibilities:**

* Designs, implements and provides products, programs, projects, processes and policies in support of the Financial Planning and Analysis function.
* Provides financial services and consulting at the branch, team and/or market level; performs analysis and interpretation of financial and other data; directly supports the Finance Manager and finance team.
* Forecasts, analyzes, and evaluates financial plans and budgets; develops recommendations to achieve financial objectives.
* Participates in expense forecasting and actuals process, including research and communication of variances.
* Prepares and distributes analytical and performance tracking reports to sales and operational team leaders.
* Builds process improvements that identify and track key operating metrics that can be leveraged to develop planning tools.
* Creates financial models to support P\&L forecasting, annual budgeting process, and evaluation of strategic business decisions.
* Interfaces with business, finance \& sales leads, accounting partners and IT to ensure accurate data and information gathering.
* Performs analysis/deep dives on profitability, revenue trends and other periodic ad\-hoc analytical projects.
* Performs ad hoc research as necessary; prepares and presents comprehensive evaluations, proposals and recommendations to appropriate leadership.
* Assists with budgeting process including preparation of templates, coordination of budget meetings, entering budget information into appropriate systems and preparation of presentation materials.
* Tracks historical capital investments and assists with monthly capital expenditure forecasting.
* Analyzes concession agreements and other third\-party contracts and monitors compliance with financial terms and obligations.
* Supports business development team by providing financial information for business reviews and by analyzing performance of competitors, including identifying trends in competitors’ behavior.
* Completes other projects and duties as assigned.

**Job** **Qualifications:**

**Education and Certifications**

* Bachelor’s degree in accounting or related field required, or equivalent combination of education, training, experience, or military experience.
* CPA Preferred

**Work Experience**

* Minimum three (3\) years related experience, in an accounting or financial analysis role.

**Skills**

* Solid knowledge of general accepted accounting principles.
* Able to prepare accurate financial reports and analyses in a timely manner.
* Able to multi\-task and stay calm under pressure.
* Strong organizational / time management skills, and be detailed oriented.
* Proficient in Microsoft software applications (i.e., Word, Excel, Outlook, and PowerPoint.) with advanced Excel skills (e.g., lookups and pivot tables).

**Competencies**

* **Accounting and Reporting \-** Applying an understanding of accounting and reporting concepts and methodologies.
* **Achievement Orientation –** Focusing efforts on achieving high quality results consistent with the organization’s standards.
* **Business Perspective** – Using an understanding of business issues, processes, and outcomes to enhance business performance.
* **Ensuring Accountability** – Holding yourself and others to high standards of accountability and creating an infrastructure and transparent corporate culture that supports and measures personal and organizational responsibility and accountability.
* **Fostering Communication** – Listening and communicating openly, honestly, and respectfully with different audiences, promoting dialogue, and building consensus.
* **Planning and organizing** – Reaching goals that are central to organizational success by making and following plans and allocating resources effectively.

**Physical Demands**

The demands described below are representative of those that must be met by an employee to successfully perform the essential functions of this job:

* Employee must have the ability to sit and/or stand at a desk for a minimum of 8 hours a day and complete tasks requiring repetitive use of hands.
* Employee must have the ability to see written documents, computer screens and to adjust focus.
* This job is performed in a temperature\-controlled office environment.

jobs.title: Senior Strategic Finance Analyst, AD&S
jobs.description:
Anduril Industries is a defense technology company with a mission to transform U.S. and allied military capabilities with advanced technology. By bringing the expertise, technology, and business model of the 21st century's most innovative companies to the defense industry, Anduril is changing how military systems are designed, built and sold. Anduril's family of systems is powered by Lattice OS, an AI\-powered operating system that turns thousands of data streams into a realtime, 3D command and control center. As the world enters an era of strategic competition, Anduril is committed to bringing cutting\-edge autonomy, AI, computer vision, sensor fusion, and networking technology to the military in months, not years.

### **ABOUT THE TEAM**



Anduril's Air Dominance \& Strike (AD\&S) division delivers platforms, systems, and integrated effects across autonomous air vehicles and advanced munitions. Our autonomous systems are the cornerstone of these capabilities, and we continually strive to push the boundaries of the possible in terms of range, autonomy, and mission capability.


### **ABOUT THE JOB**



We are hiring a Senior Strategic Finance Analyst to help drive strategic decisions for AD\&S across a variety of areas, including investment analyses, long\-range business case modeling, strategic transactions, product portfolio construction, and supporting Air Dominance \& Strikes M\&A activities.



This role is based in our Costa Mesa, CA. We are in office 5 days per week and offer relocation assistance to new employees.


#### **WHAT YOU'LL DO**


* Support critical divisional finance processes, including reporting and evolving our long\-term forecasting models to support decision\-making around expansion and operational strategies.
* Support strategic project work spanning transactions, critical investment trade\-off analyses, market research, new business model evaluations, and other business critical initiatives.
* Create high\-quality presentations for communicating AD\&S's financial performance.
* Distill our business and cost drivers into key metrics that underpin how we communicate financial performance, allocate resources, and plan for growth.
* Identify areas of opportunity across our P\&L, cash flow, and balance sheet.
* Stay current on market trends and best\-in\-class financial performance benchmarks.
* Partner cross\-functionally with Program Engineering, Supply Chain, Accounting, and Finance teams to build fidelity into our financial models.

#### **REQUIRED QUALIFICATIONS**


* 7\+ years of experience in strategic finance, corporate finance, investment banking, private equity, consulting, or another highly analytical role.
* A strong ability to critically evaluate opportunities and risks in financials.
* Expert modeling and analytical skills.
* An exemplary ability to distill complex financial information into actionable insights.
* Excellent communication skills and "story telling" ability when presenting data insights.
* An understanding of business models and metrics that are relevant to Anduril (i.e. software, manufacturing, and government contract structures).
* Strong enthusiasm about technology, production, and artificial intelligence.
* Best\-in\-class attention to detail and unwavering commitment to accuracy.
* Must be a U.S. Person due to required access to U.S. export controlled information or facilities


Per Anduril's expansion plans, we anticipate this job will be based out of Long Beach, CA beginning late 2027\.


The salary range for this role is an estimate based on a wide range of compensation factors, inclusive of base salary only. Actual salary offer may vary based on (but not limited to) work experience, education and/or training, critical skills, and/or business considerations. Highly competitive equity grants are included in the majority of full time offers; and are considered part of Anduril's total compensation package. Additionally, Anduril offers top\-tier benefits for full\-time employees, including:

  


### **Benefits**



At Anduril, we invest in our people. Our comprehensive, competitive benefits package (available at little to no cost to employees) ensures you're supported in health, recovery, and whatever comes next. *For more information,* *Explore Our Benefits**.*

  



### **Protecting Yourself from Recruitment Scams**



Anduril is committed to maintaining the integrity of our Talent acquisition process and the security of our candidates. We've observed a rise in sophisticated phishing and fraudulent schemes where individuals impersonate Anduril representatives, luring job seekers with false interviews or job offers. These scammers often attempt to extract payment or sensitive personal information.



To ensure your safety and help you navigate your job search with confidence, please keep the following critical points in mind:


* **No Financial Requests:** Anduril will never solicit payment or demand personal financial details (such as banking information, credit card numbers, or social security numbers) at any stage of our hiring process. Our legitimate recruitment is entirely free for candidates.
* **Please always verify communications:**
	+ Direct from Anduril: If you receive an email from one of our recruiters, it will *only* come from an @anduril.com address.
	+ Via Agency Partner: If contacted by a recruiting agency for an Anduril role, their email will clearly identify their agency. If you suspect any suspicious activity, please verify the agency's authenticity by reaching out to contact@anduril.com.

jobs.title: Corporate FP&A Senior Analyst
Corporate FP&A Senior Analyst
Senior Business Finance Analyst, AppDev, Google Customer Solutions
jobs.description:
### **Minimum qualifications:**

* Bachelor's degree in Business, Finance, Economics, Statistics, or another quantitative field, or equivalent practical experience.
* 7 years of experience in financial planning and analysis (FP\&A), consulting, or a related function.
* Experience in full\-cycle financial planning and analysis functions including budgeting, forecasting, variance analysis, and modeling.

  

### **Preferred qualifications:**

* Advanced degree (MBA, CFA, or other similar qualification).
* Experience leading cross\-functional project teams.
* Ability to put structure to ambiguous problems and drive insights.
* Excellent problem\-framing, problem\-structuring and project management skills.
* Excellent investigative and technical (Financial Modelling/SQL/Data Viz) skills working with large volumes of complex data.
* Excellent business judgment and leadership skills with the ability to communicate with clarity and engage with an executive management team.

**About the job**
-----------------


Financial Analysts ensure that Google makes sound financial decisions. As a Financial Analyst, your work, whether it's modeling business scenarios or tracking performance metrics, is used by our leaders to make strategic company decisions. Working on multiple projects at a time, you are focused on the details while finding creative ways to take on big picture challenges.  

  

As someone who knows the workings of the core Finance team inside and out, you'll lead individual projects to transform planning, tracking and control processes. You'll provide senior level management with insightful recommendations, planning and reporting support.



This role offers you the opportunity to partner with Global App Developers (AppDev) (Google Customer Solutions) Leadership to build the future of the App Developers digital ecosystem. The AppDev team focuses on supporting and growing clients with mobile applications. Their main goal is to help these clients succeed and increase their investment in Google's app advertising solutions to drive installs and reengagement with their app.  

  

In this role, you will work with executive sales leaders and key partners to enable robust decision\-making by understanding their business, leading cross\-functional efforts to grow the product area, and providing the strategic financial leadership required to manage complex portfolios. You will be a well\-rounded top performer who can lead macro\-business modeling initiatives and grow in a high\-energy growth environment.


The name Google came from "googol," a mathematical term for the number 1 followed by 100 zeros. And nobody at Google loves big numbers like the Finance team when providing in depth analysis on all manner of strategic decisions across Google products. From developing forward\-thinking analysis to generating management reports to scaling our automated financial processes, the Finance organization is an important partner and advisor to the business.


Individual pay is determined by factors including job\-related skills, experience, and relevant education or training.
  

  

US: $141000 \- $205000 (USD) \+ 15% bonus target \+ equity \+ benefits  

  

Learn more about benefits at Google.**Responsibilities**
--------------------

* Act as a Trusted advisor to Sales Leaders (Director\+) on business performance and finance related priorities. Provide management with clear insights and recommendations.
* Drive projects and initiatives end\-to\-end for Financial Planning and Analysis and support large, cross\-functional, complex projects and initiatives.
* Drive business strategy across the AppDev Business. Define financial analysis objectives, build top\-line analytical frameworks, and effectively prioritize activities that highlight opportunities and gaps in programs/product/App verticals performance.
* Lead investigative deep dives separately in partnership with finance and cross\-functional partners.
* Partner effectively with finance, sales, sales operations and strategy in country, regional and global teams. Partner closely with other Finance teams and Revenue Strategy and Operations (RSO) to drive aligned business strategies.

jobs.title: QA Release Management Analyst 3 (5472C), Campus Applications & Data, #89084
jobs.description:
QA Release Management Analyst 3 (5472C), Campus Applications \& Data, \#89084 About Berkeley
  
  

At the University of California, Berkeley , we are dedicated to fostering a community where everyone feels welcome and can thrive. Our culture of openness, freedom, and belonging makes it a special place for students, faculty, and staff, who are among the most talented and accomplished anywhere, including Nobel laureates, Pulitzer Prize winners, and MacArthur Fellows. Since our founding in 1868, we have been an engine for innovation \- driving intellectual, economic, and social progress that benefits California, the U.S., and beyond. Together, we change the world.
  
  

At Berkeley, the best careers are built on a foundation of continuous learning and growth . We actively support professional development by providing all full\-time staff employees with at least 80 hours of paid time per year and provide space for supportive colleague communities via numerous employee resource groups.
  
  

We invite applicants who are inspired by our Principles of Community and who are eager to be part of our exciting Strategic Plan , which charts Berkeley's next era of excellence.
  
  

Learn more about some of our accomplishments at Points of Pride .
  
  

Departmental Overview
  
  

Campus Applications \& Data, a unit within the Office of the Chief Information Officer, provides application systems development and best practices for enterprise and unit\-specific software supporting administrative, academic, and public service functions.
  
  

Within this unit, the Student Integrated System (SIS) team is responsible for designing, configuring, testing, and maintaining software applications that support key campus functions, including admissions, enrollment, registration, financial aid, student accounts, advising, and the student portal. The team focuses on system improvements as well as automation \& performance testing to better meet the needs of the campus community.
  
  

Position Summary
  
  

The QA Release Management Analyst 3 serves as an experienced Quality Assurance analyst within the Student Integrated System (SIS) team. This position aligns quality assurance initiatives and testing standards with institutional priorities and SIS development cycles to safeguard data integrity, system reliability, and service excellence for the campus community.
  
  

This position is responsible for developing, executing, troubleshooting, and maintaining both automated and manual tests, as well as evaluating, revising, applying, and documenting technical quality assurance protocols and methods to inspect and validate a variety of IT processes, programs, and products. This role also prepares for, supports, and implements performance testing each release period, providing analysis and suggestions for system performance improvements. Additionally, the QA Release Management Analyst 3 performs analysis to identify trends and suggests corrective actions, supports compliance with UC and external quality assurance standards, and provides consultation and guidance to Berkeley IT teams in improving their quality assurance practices and automated testing capabilities.
  
  

Application Review Date
  
  

**The First Review Date for this job is:** October 8, 2026
  
  

For full consideration, please apply on or before the first review date.
  
  

Responsibilities
  
  

Quality Assurance \& Performance Testing \- 75%
  
  

Applies advanced quality assurance (QA) concepts to perform complex testing procedures, ensuring that all information systems products and services meet organizational standards and end\-user requirements.
  
Analyzes, develops, and conducts complex software testing to verify proper system operation, identifying and reporting any defects. Executes regression and validation testing to assess the impact of new code changes on existing functionality. * Generates highly complex reports and performs data analysis to proactively plan or resolve issues.
* Works with inventory management/warehouse management to resolve issues.

* Bachelor degree in Business, Supply Chain or equivalent experience.
* 3\+ years of progressively responsible experience in purchasing

* Ability to leverage and/or engage others to accomplish projects.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* 1\+ year SAP ERP experience placing purchase orders and running MRP
* High proficiency with Microsoft Excel and PowerPoint

**Apply Now**

**Learn more about our health and wellness benefits, which provide the security to help you and your family live full lives:** www.abbottbenefits.com


Follow your career aspirations to Abbott for diverse opportunities with a company that can help you build your future and live your best life. Abbott is an Equal Opportunity Employer, committed to employee diversity.


Connect with us at www.abbott.com, on Facebook at www.facebook.com/Abbott, and on Twitter @AbbottNews.

jobs.title: Senior Global FP&A Specialist - OPEX COS
jobs.description:
**Make an impact at NTT Global Data Centers**

Join NTT Global Data Centers and be part of a team that drives innovation and sustainability in the digital world. With over 150 data centers across more than 20 countries globally, we offer unparalleled opportunities to work on cutting\-edge technology and transformative projects. Experience a collaborative, innovative, and inclusive workplace where your ideas are valued, and your growth is supported.


**Your role at a glance**

The Senior Global FP\&A Specialist – OPEX COS is responsible for analyzing, consolidating, and reporting operational expenditures across the organization’s global data center operations. The role partners with Finance, Data Center Operations, and regional teams to provide accurate, timely, and actionable insights into OPEX performance.
  

  

The Senior Specialist performs end\-to\-end OPEX analysis and reporting, identifying trends, monitoring budget performance for a limited set of specific, high attention assets, and preparing reports for management and executives.
  

  

The role requires a highly experienced FP\&A professional capable of delivering insights and analysis with minimal supervision.
**What we are looking for**

KEY RESPONSIBILITIES  



  

***Communication***

* Act as a senior financial business partner by proactively generating insights, leading strategic analyses, and representing the CoS team at senior management level while shaping key operational decisions.
* Proactively monitor, interpret, and communicate key financial and operational KPIs to influence decisions and strengthen performance management.
* Actively collaborate with business stakeholders and finance partners by initiating the collection of budgeting inputs, contract details, and cost drivers, ensuring complete and accurate financial planning.
* Support the business and other stakeholders in understanding, forecasting and budgeting operational expense for a datacenter.
* Actively collaborate within the global FP\&A community by initiating knowledge sharing and contributing to the development of cross\-functional best practices.

Performs any other relevant task as assigned by the management team.  

* 

***Analysis***

* Deeply understand OPEX data from multiple data centers on a very granular level (supplier contracts, maintenance plans, etc.).
* Actively design and deliver monthly actual\-vs\-budget and forecast reporting, generating clear variance insights at a very detailed level and driving action\-oriented follow\-ups with stakeholders.
* Proactively identify, quantify, and track risks, opportunities, and performance levers to support operational business improvement.
* Proactively assess and challenge business initiatives to ensure alignment with required profitability expectations and long\-term value creation.
* Actively identify and shape cost\-management opportunities to drive sustainable operational and financial performance.
* Actively lead budget and expense reviews on a very detailed level for a few, special attention datacenters, highlight variances early, and initiate cost\-optimization opportunities.
Performs other duties and adhoc analytics as assigned.  
* 

***Process \& Tool improvements***

* Actively drive the design and continuous innovation of reporting tools and templates to ensure operational impacts and financial implications are captured transparently and effectively.
* Actively maintain, enhance, and further innovate tools and templates supporting cost analysis, forecasting, and operational decision\-making.
* Actively drive system improvements by testing, validating, and shaping enhancements across planning platforms such as SAC, SAP, and Power BI.
Proactively contribute to system releases by initiating and executing user testing, ensuring functional and high\-quality platform improvements.  
* 

KNOWLEDGE \& ATTRIBUTES


* Strong expertise in FP\&A processes related to OPEX budgeting, forecasting, consolidation, and reporting.
* Familiarity with data center operational costs, including energy, maintenance, and service delivery costs.
* Proficiency with FP\&A and reporting tools (e.g., Excel, Power BI, SAP, SAC).
* Excellent analytical, problem\-solving, and critical\-thinking skills.
* Able to manage complex, multi\-region OPEX data and reporting deadlines independently.
* Strong business acumen and ability to communicate financial insights effectively to stakeholders.

Detail\-oriented, organized, and capable of producing accurate and timely reports.  

* 

  

ACADEMIC QUALIFICATIONS \& CERTIFICATIONS  



  

* Bachelor’s degree in Finance, Accounting, Economics, or a related field.
Professional certification preferred (e.g., CPA, CMA, CFA, or equivalent).  
* 

  

REQUIRED EXPERIENCE  



  

* 6–10 years of experience in FP\&A, OPEX analysis, or financial reporting within a global, multi\-entity organization.
* Experience in OPEX forecasting, budgeting, and reporting.
* Experience with FP\&A and reporting systems (e.g., Excel, Power BI, SAP, SAC).
Demonstrated ability to perform complex financial analysis and deliver actionable insights with minimal supervision.  
* 

PHYSICAL REQUIREMENTS  



* Remain stationary for long periods of time.
* Operate computer, peripherals, and other office equipment.
Perform work during US business hours and time zones.  
* 

WORK CONDITIONS AND OTHER REQUIREMENTS  



  

* Very limited one\-off travel (once or twice annually).
* Perform work from a remote location with stable internet connection.

**Compensation Pay Range**

For roles residing in the US, we share pay and benefit levels to support pay transparency requirements. For other countries, we are more than happy to share our competitive pay and benefit levels during the interview process.  



  

This is a remote position that requires reliable internet connection and electricity. A monthly stipend is provided to cover expenses associated with working remotely and use of a personal mobile device

jobs.title: Sr. Financial Planning and Analysis Analyst
jobs.description:
Provider Resources, Inc. (PRI) is hiring a Senior Financial Analyst to own our Opex budget and forecast and to produce the analysis our leadership and board rely on each month. This role is for someone who builds models from a blank sheet, writes variance commentary that ends in a recommendation, and is comfortable in a room with senior leaders.


#### **About PRI**


PRI is a certified Independent Dispute Resolution Entity (IDRE) under the federal No Surprises Act and an accredited Independent Review Organization (IRO). We resolve payment disputes between health care providers and health plans. We have about 200 employees, all in the United States, and the business is growing quickly.


#### **What You Will Do**

* Own the Opex budget and forecast, working directly with department leaders on their inputs.
* Build financial models from scratch for budgeting, forecasting, scenarios, and business cases.
* Write the monthly variance analysis and the commentary that goes with it.
* Prepare the monthly and weekly leadership packages and the boardready package.
* Build and maintain the KPI dashboards leadership uses.
* Guide and review the work of our Financial Analyst.
* Improve how FPandA works at PRI as the company grows.

#### **What You Bring**

* 5\+ years of FPandA or financial analysis experience, including ownership of a budget or forecast process for a defined cost area.
* Advanced Excel modeling, including building threestatement or driverbased models from a blank sheet.
* Demonstrated monthly variance analysis with written management commentary for a leadership audience.
* Experience preparing leadership or board reporting packages.
* Bachelor's degree in Finance, Accounting, or Economics.
* Clear written and verbal communication of financial information to nonfinance audiences.

#### **Nice to Have**

* Healthcare, health plan, or claims payment industry experience; familiarity with the No Surprises Act or IDR process is a plus.
* Experience in a PEbacked or sponsorreporting environment.
* Financial planning software experience.
* Power BI, Tableau, or comparable BI tool experience for KPI dashboards.

This role reports to the Director, FPandA.

Our work supports a broad network of stakeholders, including providers, patients, caregivers, payers, and regulators. We strive to enhance experiences, improve outcomes, and foster a healthier future for all. If you’re looking to be part of a forward\-thinking team that makes a difference, PRI is the place for you!

jobs.title: Senior Finance Analyst - Commercial Performance & Investment Review
jobs.description:
**Purpose**


The Senior Finance Analyst \- Commercial Performance \& Investment Review will provide high\-quality analysis and insight to improve the financial performance of major commercial contracts and investments through Post Investment Reviews (PIRs), benefits realization analysis and enhanced pricing governance.


The role will work closely with regional Finance teams and Group Commercial Finance, providing analysis and insight to improve future Investment Appraisals, pricing decisions and commercial performance.


**Essential Duties / Key Accountabilities**


**Post Investment Reviews \& Benefits Realization**


* Prepare and complete Post Investment Reviews for qualifying Investment Appraisals in line with the Group PIR framework and agreed review timetable.
* Compare original IA or business case assumptions with actual financial and operational performance across revenue, net revenue, margin, EBITDA, capex, opex and other relevant KPIs.
* Identify and quantify the key drivers of over\- and under\-performance, working with Finance, Commercial and Operational stakeholders to understand the underlying causes.
* Assess whether the financial and strategic benefits set out in the original IA have been realized.
* Support the identification of opportunities and practical actions to improve the performance of existing contracts and investments.
* Track actions arising from PIRs, maintain accurate PIR records for regional and Group reporting, and identify recurring trends such as forecast bias, pricing issues, cost assumptions or execution challenges.


**Investment Appraisal \& Commercial Decision Support**


* Apply insights from completed PIRs to support improvements in future Investment Appraisals and business cases.
* Develop historical performance benchmarks and use them to test revenue, margin, cost and investment assumptions, working with Commercial and Finance teams so previous experience informs future bids and investment decisions.
* Support Group Commercial Finance in developing consistent approaches to benefits realisation and commercial performance measurement.


**Rate Cards \& Pricing Governance**


* Support the maintenance and ongoing administration of regional rate cards as the Group Rate Card initiative transitions into business as usual.
* Coordinate periodic reviews and refreshes so rate cards reflect current costs, market conditions and required returns, working with Commercial, Finance and Operational teams to validate the underlying assumptions and methodology.
* Monitor usage of approved rate cards and analyze pricing to identify trends in discounting and pricing performance.
* Support governance around deviations from standard rate cards, ensuring appropriate approvals are obtained, and identify opportunities to improve pricing consistency and commercial discipline.
* Analyze the financial impact of pricing changes, support implementation of agreed pricing actions and share regional insights with Group Commercial Finance to drive consistency across the Group.


**Business Partnering**


* Build strong relationships across regional Finance, Commercial, Sales and Operational teams, working with contract and business owners to identify practical improvement opportunities.
* Prepare and present PIR findings and recommendations clearly to senior regional stakeholders, providing evidence\-based commercial challenge with support from Group Commercial Finance where appropriate.
* Serve as a key regional contact for Group Commercial Finance on PIRs, benefits realization and rate card governance.


**Key Deliverables / Measures of Success**


* Completion of qualifying PIRs in line with the agreed timetable, measured by PIR coverage and completion rate.
* Improved visibility of actual performance versus approved IA assumptions.
* Identification and implementation of actions arising from PIR findings, with evidence that lessons learned are incorporated into future Investment Appraisals.
* Timely refresh and validation of regional rate cards, with increased rate card coverage and usage.
* Improved visibility of realized pricing and discounting, and identification of opportunities to improve commercial performance and profitability.


**Position Requirements**


**Essential**


* Qualified accountant or equivalent finance qualification, ideally with 2\-3 years of post\-qualified experience in commercial finance, FP\&A, business partnering or a similar analytical role.
* Demonstrable post\-qualified experience operating at Senior Finance Analyst level, with the ability to take ownership of analysis and deliver work to agreed timelines.
* Strong financial analysis, Excel and modelling skills, with a firm grasp of P\&L, revenue, margin and EBITDA drivers.
* Experience reviewing business cases, commercial contracts, investment proposals or project profitability.
* Able to translate financial and operational data into clear commercial insights and recommendations.
* Strong communicator, able to explain complex analysis clearly, challenge assumptions constructively and build credibility with senior Finance, Commercial and Operational stakeholders.


**Desirable**


* Experience in a project, contract or service\-based business, ideally multi\-region or international.
* Experience of pricing, rate cards, commercial bids or contract profitability analysis.
* Experience of investment appraisal, benefits realization or post\-investment reviews, ideally in a private equity\-backed or performance\-focused environment.

* Commercially minded and curious about the drivers of business performance.
* Strong analytical and problem\-solving capability, moving beyond variances to root causes and practical actions.
* Comfortable bringing structure to complex commercial issues and imperfect data.

The Buyer role is an integral part of the Sales Planning and Forecasting department. The primary responsibility of the Buyer I is the placement of purchase orders and the monitoring of inventory levels for finished goods. **About Unrivaled Teamwear**



Unrivaled Teamwear is the fast\-growing parent company behind Gear for Sports and Knights Apparel. Headquartered in Lenexa, Kansas, we design, decorate, and deliver team gear — tees, fleece, performance wear, outerwear, headwear, and accessories — for customers ranging from big box retailers, college bookstores, golf courses and resorts, and national retailers.



We've grown quickly over the past year and expect that growth to continue. We are looking for motivated candidates looking to grow their career alongside the business.

new_jobs.title: Senior Global FP&A Specialist - OPEX COS
new_jobs.description:
**Make an impact at NTT Global Data Centers**

Join NTT Global Data Centers and be part of a team that drives innovation and sustainability in the digital world. With over 150 data centers across more than 20 countries globally, we offer unparalleled opportunities to work on cutting\-edge technology and transformative projects. Experience a collaborative, innovative, and inclusive workplace where your ideas are valued, and your growth is supported.


**Your role at a glance**

The Senior Global FP\&A Specialist – OPEX COS is responsible for analyzing, consolidating, and reporting operational expenditures across the organization’s global data center operations. The role partners with Finance, Data Center Operations, and regional teams to provide accurate, timely, and actionable insights into OPEX performance.
  

  

The Senior Specialist performs end\-to\-end OPEX analysis and reporting, identifying trends, monitoring budget performance for a limited set of specific, high attention assets, and preparing reports for management and executives.
  

  

The role requires a highly experienced FP\&A professional capable of delivering insights and analysis with minimal supervision.
**What we are looking for**

KEY RESPONSIBILITIES  



  

***Communication***

* Act as a senior financial business partner by proactively generating insights, leading strategic analyses, and representing the CoS team at senior management level while shaping key operational decisions.
* Proactively monitor, interpret, and communicate key financial and operational KPIs to influence decisions and strengthen performance management.
* Actively collaborate with business stakeholders and finance partners by initiating the collection of budgeting inputs, contract details, and cost drivers, ensuring complete and accurate financial planning.
* Support the business and other stakeholders in understanding, forecasting and budgeting operational expense for a datacenter.
* Actively collaborate within the global FP\&A community by initiating knowledge sharing and contributing to the development of cross\-functional best practices.

Performs any other relevant task as assigned by the management team.  

* 

***Analysis***

* Deeply understand OPEX data from multiple data centers on a very granular level (supplier contracts, maintenance plans, etc.).
* Actively design and deliver monthly actual\-vs\-budget and forecast reporting, generating clear variance insights at a very detailed level and driving action\-oriented follow\-ups with stakeholders.
* Proactively identify, quantify, and track risks, opportunities, and performance levers to support operational business improvement.
* Proactively assess and challenge business initiatives to ensure alignment with required profitability expectations and long\-term value creation.
* Actively identify and shape cost\-management opportunities to drive sustainable operational and financial performance.
* Actively lead budget and expense reviews on a very detailed level for a few, special attention datacenters, highlight variances early, and initiate cost\-optimization opportunities.
Performs other duties and adhoc analytics as assigned.  
* 

***Process \& Tool improvements***

* Actively drive the design and continuous innovation of reporting tools and templates to ensure operational impacts and financial implications are captured transparently and effectively.
* Actively maintain, enhance, and further innovate tools and templates supporting cost analysis, forecasting, and operational decision\-making.
* Actively drive system improvements by testing, validating, and shaping enhancements across planning platforms such as SAC, SAP, and Power BI.
Proactively contribute to system releases by initiating and executing user testing, ensuring functional and high\-quality platform improvements.  
* 

KNOWLEDGE \& ATTRIBUTES


* Strong expertise in FP\&A processes related to OPEX budgeting, forecasting, consolidation, and reporting.
* Familiarity with data center operational costs, including energy, maintenance, and service delivery costs.
* Proficiency with FP\&A and reporting tools (e.g., Excel, Power BI, SAP, SAC).
* Excellent analytical, problem\-solving, and critical\-thinking skills.
* Able to manage complex, multi\-region OPEX data and reporting deadlines independently.
* Strong business acumen and ability to communicate financial insights effectively to stakeholders.

Detail\-oriented, organized, and capable of producing accurate and timely reports.  

* 

  

ACADEMIC QUALIFICATIONS \& CERTIFICATIONS  



  

* Bachelor’s degree in Finance, Accounting, Economics, or a related field.
Professional certification preferred (e.g., CPA, CMA, CFA, or equivalent).  
* 

  

REQUIRED EXPERIENCE  



  

* 6–10 years of experience in FP\&A, OPEX analysis, or financial reporting within a global, multi\-entity organization.
* Experience in OPEX forecasting, budgeting, and reporting.
* Experience with FP\&A and reporting systems (e.g., Excel, Power BI, SAP, SAC).
Demonstrated ability to perform complex financial analysis and deliver actionable insights with minimal supervision.  
* 

PHYSICAL REQUIREMENTS  



* Remain stationary for long periods of time.
* Operate computer, peripherals, and other office equipment.
Perform work during US business hours and time zones.  
* 

WORK CONDITIONS AND OTHER REQUIREMENTS  



  

* Very limited one\-off travel (once or twice annually).
* Perform work from a remote location with stable internet connection.

**Compensation Pay Range**

For roles residing in the US, we share pay and benefit levels to support pay transparency requirements. For other countries, we are more than happy to share our competitive pay and benefit levels during the interview process.  



  

This is a remote position that requires reliable internet connection and electricity. A monthly stipend is provided to cover expenses associated with working remotely and use of a personal mobile device
